title: Joseph
summary: Son of Jacob and Rachel; sold into Egypt, made ruler over Egypt at 30 (Gen 37–50).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1745 BC (Joseph born) (no higher-tier year available).

birth.note: Year cell "2942 2260 177". The third printed figure 177 is the column "Promise", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 110 at the end of the name is the lifespan he prints. His table also prints the death at World 2369. 2260 + 110 is not 2369. Both figures are left as printed.
